wave_review_comment:
## Wave 2 contract refresh

The human cleared every retained lane and added one bounded harness item. Measurement may fan out immediately; implementation in the three engine-core files remains strictly one-at-a-time. Lifecycle goes first and must float if current evidence reveals migration, release semantics, destructive backfill, or decomposition too large for a bounded wave.

Proof remains the governing standard: live red before, green after, independent APPROVE, Linux and non-Windows CI green. Windows may remain red, but its node set is still recorded.

Codex agents are tiered deliberately: Sol for high-risk engine work/review, Terra for bounded implementation, Luna for mechanical measurement and verification.
revised_epic_body:
## Current planning truth — wave 2 authorized

Wave 1's location substrate is on main. Wave 2 now covers lease lifecycle, binding-store durability, #530, #510, and durable Codex model-tier routing. Planning and evidence gathering fan out; engine-core implementation is serialized. Lifecycle complexity is a mandatory human float.

Success means provable behavior, not patches: red/green repros or honest nulls, independent review, Linux/non-Windows green, exact merged state. Windows-only failures are allowed and recorded. Consumer packages remain deferred.
